```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidybayes)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
library(lme4)
library(priorsense)
library(projpred)
library(corrplot) 

cmdstan_installed <- function(){
  res <- try(out <- cmdstanr::cmdstan_path(), silent = TRUE)
  !inherits(res, "try-error")
}
if(!cmdstan_installed()){
    install_cmdstan()
}

set.seed(42)
```


## Fetch and process data

```{r data loading}
files <- list.files("../data/raw", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

dfs <- files |> map(read_csv, na = c("", "NA", "-"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Helper function to split into no2 stations and weather stations by which columns they contain
has_col <- \(pat, dataframe) keep(dataframe, \(d) any(str_detect(names(d), pat)))

key <- c("year", "month", "day", "time")
clean <- \(d) rename(d, station = `Observation station`, year = Year, month = Month,
                     day = Day, time = `Time [Local time]`)

# Make dataframe of weather data
weather <- has_col("^Maximum wind", dfs) |>
  map(clean) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  rename(wind = starts_with("Maximum wind"),
         precip = starts_with("Precipitation"),
         temp = starts_with("Average temp"))

# Make dataframe of no2 data
nitrogen <- has_col("^Nitrogen", dfs) |>
  map(clean) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  rename(no2 = starts_with("Nitrogen"))


#Regional hourly mean across the 3 weather stations
weather_summarized <- weather |> summarise(across(c(wind, precip, temp), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .by = all_of(key))   

dat <- nitrogen |>
  left_join(weather_summarized, by = key) |>
  mutate(station = factor(station),
         datetime = make_datetime(year, month, day, as.integer(str_sub(time, 1, 2)), tz = "UTC"),
         hour = hour(datetime),
         wday = wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
         across(c(wind, precip, temp), \(x) as.numeric(scale(x)), .names = "{.col}_z")) |>
  drop_na(no2, temp, wind, precip) |>
  arrange(station, datetime)

dat_main <- subset(dat, no2 > 0) |> 
  mutate(log_no2 = log(no2),
         lwind_z = as.numeric(scale(log1p(wind))),
         yday    = yday(datetime),
         wday_f  = factor(wday),
         weekend = as.numeric(wday >= 6))

```

```{r}
preds <- c("temp_z", "lwind_z", "precip", "hour", "yday", "wday")

# Correlation heatmap
cm <- dat_main |> select(log_no2, all_of(preds)) |> cor(method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
corrplot(cm, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black", number.cex = 0.8, col = COL2("RdBu", 200))

# Check by station correlations
dat_main |> group_by(station) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(preds), \(x) cor(x, log_no2, method = "spearman")))

# Check by station slopes with a linear model
dat_main |>
  group_by(station) |>
  summarise(wind_slope = coef(lm(log_no2 ~ temp_z + lwind_z + wday))["lwind_z"],
            temp_slope = coef(lm(log_no2 ~ temp_z + lwind_z + wday))["temp_z"],
            weekend_slope = coef(lm(log_no2 ~ temp_z + lwind_z + weekend))["weekend"])
```


## Modeling
```{r modeling, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Define formula
no2_hierarchical_formula_main <- bf(
  log_no2 ~ temp_z * lwind_z + weekend + (1 + weekend | station) + 
    s(hour, bs = 'cc') + s(yday, bs = 'cc'),
  family = "gaussian",
  center = FALSE
)

# Define priors
no2_hierarchical_priors_main <- c(
  prior(normal(log(10), 1), class = "b",     coef = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1),       class = "b"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),     class = "sd",    coef = "Intercept", group = "station"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5),     class = "sd",    coef = "weekend",   group = "station"),
  prior(normal(0, 2),       class = "sigma", lb = 0),
  prior(normal(0, 1),       class = "sds"),
  prior(lkj(2),             class = "cor")
  )

# Fit, consider changing cores and threads to better suit your machine.
no2_hierarchical_fit_main <- brm(
    formula = no2_hierarchical_formula_main,
    data    = dat_main,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    chains  = 4,
    cores   = 4,
    threads = threading(threads = 4),
    file    = file.path("saved_models", "main_model_v3"),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
    seed    = 42,
    )
```

## Evaluation of model

```{r pp}
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "ecdf_overlay", ndraws = 100)
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "loo_pit_overlay", ndraws = 300)
```


```{r more pp}
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "stat_grouped", group = "station", stat = "mean", ndraws = 200)
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "stat_grouped", group = "station", stat = "sd",   ndraws = 200)
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "stat_grouped", group = "station", stat = "max",  ndraws = 200)
pp_check(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, type = "stat_grouped", group = "station", stat = \(y) quantile(y, 0.95), ndraws = 200)
```


```{r summary and loo}
summary(no2_hierarchical_fit_main)

no2_hierarchical_fit_main <- add_criterion(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, criterion = "loo")
loo(no2_hierarchical_fit_main)
```


```{r conditional effects}
me <- conditional_effects(no2_hierarchical_fit_main, re_formula = NULL)
plot(me, ncol = 4, points = TRUE, ask = FALSE)  
```


```{r prior analysis}
powerscale_sensitivity(no2_hierarchical_fit_main)
```
